title: Research
subtitle: Feed it to learn
text:
The Research Station is a powered machine that eats resources. Choose a project with the arrows and feed it the items it asks for. Research is yours alone, like an entangled code: a station belongs to whoever placed it, and everything it eats counts for its owner. When a project is done, its world types and resources unlock for you.

Mob research needs scans. Charge a Mob Scanner in a charger and use it on a mob. Scans count for whoever holds the scanner, and each player can scan a mob once.

A station starts public: anyone may use it to imprint cards with what its owner has learned. The owner can make it private with a screwdriver, and then only they can open it.

Put a blank Jump Card in the card slot and press Imprint to program it with the chosen project. A gate also belongs to whoever placed it and picks world types from its owner's research.
